name: Haus Vinterdread
motto: Winter is the final boss. We are its heralds.

game_start: The northern blizzard awakens. Let the ice decide our fates.
The ravens circle above the board. Valhalla awaits the fallen.
From the whiteout of Jötunheim, the Dread Wizard enters.
Draw your blades. In this winter, only the resolute endure.
player_captured: A worthy sacrifice to the northern gale.
The Valkyries sing your piece to sleep.
Runes carved in frost cannot be unwritten.
rival_captured: A fierce strike, but the blizzard only thickens.
Blood on the snow. The wolves smell the turning tide.
You wound the mountain, yet the mountain stands.
A fine trade. The Allfather smiles upon boldness.
check_given: The frost-staff points at your king. Yield to the storm.
Check. The antlers of the Wendigo cast a long shadow.
Nowhere to run on this frozen board.
The final boss has arrived for your crown.
check_received: A sharp frostbite, but our roots run deep in the permafrost.
You press the sovereign, yet winter does not yield.
The blizzard swirls tighter around our king.
Bold advance. Let us see if your line holds the frost.
game_end: Skål! The winter feast begins in the great hall.
A glorious saga etched into the ice for all time.
The storm clears. Honor to all who crossed the board.
The saga is sung. Until the next blizzard.
